answer: The glacier counter is kept in island and ledge shows each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 17 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 17 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3845 identities would post 4248 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
